{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue — remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
num_internal_orders = len(internal_test_orders)

# Filter out internal test orders
df_filtered = df[~df['revenue_clean'].isin([999999.99])]

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df_filtered[df_filtered['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = df_completed['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the required numbers
print(num_internal_orders)
print(total_revenue)

# Return total_revenue for submission
total_revenue"}
